title: TEST WHEEL FOR THE PROOF OF CONCEPT
abstract: A test wheel with a rim, a hub and spokes connecting them, used only to check the ingestion pipeline.
claims: 1 . A wheel comprising a rim, a hub and a plurality of spokes connecting the rim to the hub.
2 . The wheel of claim 1 , wherein the spokes are hollow.
detailed_description: The wheel has a rim and a hub joined by twelve spokes made of steel tube.
